# Bito feature recordings

User-supplied MP4 recordings, 12 November 2026. Original files remain unchanged in Downloads.

- ask-on-screen.mp4: original 13.65-second video stream, fast-start MP4.
- show-on-screen.mp4: first 14.4 seconds; removed the trailing blank white export.
- project-management.mp4: first 15.2 seconds; removed the trailing blank white export.

All website versions are silent, 1920 × 1080. JPG posters are frames at 7, 9 and 12 seconds respectively. Click the video to play or pause it, and use the progress line to seek. Playback starts only when visible and pauses offscreen or in a hidden tab. Reduced motion disables automatic playback.
